about: Hand-written red-team set for the input, memory and retrieval guardrails. expect=block means the request must be stopped (or the passage quarantined); expect=pass means it must go through. Real report passages (clean) and the same passages with an injected instruction (poisoned) are added by scripts/eval_guardrails.py. The heldout list was written after the rules were final and is never used to tune them: its score estimates how the rules do on attacks they were not written for. heldout_v2 was written before the semantic stage was calibrated and is the clean test of the two-stage detector (heldout v1's misses were seen while designing that stage).
